explication: Timeline Visualizer turns an exported Google Timeline file into a configurable animated travel video, on Android and in a private iPhone web app. The main Android workflow imports route history into a local Travel Journal, selects a trip or date range, previews the map, then exports and catalogs an MP4. The graph also preserves documented trip recaps, presets, settings, reminders, and video-library actions. Sampled code confirms route projection, tile caching, export-service, and web entry-point behavior; other connections follow README capabilities and are shown conservatively.
